d6Transparency.how.title: How we count viewers
d6Transparency.how.intro: Every viewer number here is a verified viewer: someone a real player is showing the stream to, checked by the co-op's integrity checks. Sessions that look automated, and sessions still being checked, never count.
d6Transparency.how.live: The number on a live stream is the verified viewers watching right now, counted every few seconds. People catching up on an earlier part of the stream are not in it. It is a live figure, so it can move.
d6Transparency.how.settled: About two hours after a stream ends, the co-op settles its numbers: peak viewers and watch time, from every session it verified. Settled numbers are the final ones, and the only ones analytics, the stream recap and audience statements use.
d6Transparency.how.statements: A creator can share a signed audience statement with a sponsor. It carries the settled numbers, signed by this co-op, so anyone can check it hasn't been changed.
d6Transparency.note.title: Month notes
d6Transparency.note.hint: Treasurers only. A short public note on a month's books, for example how a gap is covered. It shows on this page for everyone. Never include personal data.
d6Transparency.note.bodyHint: Public. Leave it empty and save to remove the note.
d6Transparency.note.removeBody: It disappears from the transparency page for everyone. The change is recorded in the audit log.
